blinding_compliance: I reviewed only the blind/V025 packet and publicly accessible technical standards; I did not inspect the repository outside this directory, coordinator directory, hidden truth files, scoring code, other reviewers' outputs, or web search the benchmark. I did not consult or delegate to another reviewer.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Causal attribution of the baseline off-target condition to a specific applicator/nozzle; the one-way ANOVA does not identify one and absence of a significant difference is not equivalence.
Causal attribution of the post-change improvement to the unrecorded intervention or any named physical change; the pre/post comparison is observational.
Final declaration that the post-change process is stable and capable as a permanent state from only 20 provisional observations and provisional I-MR limits.
Use of post-change capability estimates as more than descriptive/provisional evidence without continued monitoring and recalculation.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Proceeding with process analysis after the crossed gage R&R because GRR% is within the AIAG MSA-4 acceptance band and ndc>=5.
Describing the baseline with mean/median/sd/min/max and reporting all 125 readings above the 260 um USL.
Concluding baseline temporal stability using an X-bar/R chart of 25 ordered subgroups of 5 consecutive pieces under a point-limit screen, with no X-bar or range flags.
Computing normality-based capability indices for the stable baseline and concluding the baseline is incapable because it is centered above the upper specification limit.
Comparing applicator means with Levene's test and one-way ANOVA, concluding only that no single applicator is established as the cause and proposing a common-cause hypothesis.
Making a descriptive pre/post comparison, a provisional I-MR chart, and provisional post-change capability estimates, while explicitly treating them as limited and continuing monitoring.
Recommending preservation of the current post-change condition, documentation of settings, gauge repeatability improvement, and no individual-nozzle tuning without evidence.
reviews.extra_computation_detail: Capability analysis, applicator ANOVA/Levene, post-change I-MR and capability, and pre/post descriptive comparison are valid follow-on analyses conditional on the stable baseline and on treating post-change results as provisional/observational. The report does exactly that. Step 13 repurposes descriptive statistic fields for change quantities, but the reported change values are arithmetically correct and traceable.
allowed_alternatives: X-bar/R for the 25 ordered subgroups if consecutive pieces form rational subgroups and autocorrelation is absent or minimal.
Normality-based capability after the Anderson-Darling test fails to reject normality in the stable baseline.
One-way ANOVA and Levene's test for applicator comparison, interpreted as a test of mean differences and not a demonstration of equivalence.
I-MR and provisional capability for the 20 post-change individuals as descriptive/provisional only, with continued monitoring and recalculated limits after a longer stable record.
evidence: MSA crossed study: 90 readings, 3 operators, 10 parts, 3 replicates; percent study variation 12.27%, percent tolerance 11.35%, ndc 11.
Baseline descriptive: mean 291.34 um, median 291.13 um, sd 7.74 um, min 272.04 um, max 311.40 um, n=125.
Baseline control chart: X-bar center 291.34 um, UCL 301.45 um, LCL 281.23 um; R-bar 17.53 um, R UCL 37.05 um; 0 X-bar flags, 0 range flags.
Baseline capability: Cp 1.769, Cpk -1.386, Pp 1.722, Ppk -1.349; all 125 readings above 260 um, outside-specification rate 100%.
Post-change descriptive: mean 219.25 um, sd 5.08 um, n=20, 0 outside 180-260 um.
Post-change I-MR: I UCL 237.42, I LCL 201.08; moving range UCL 22.32; 0 individual flags, 0 moving-range flags.
Pre/post change: mean shift -72.09 um, absolute target offset reduction 70.59 um, sd change -2.66 um, outside-specification rate change -100 percentage points.
reviews.rationale: The measurement system passes the applicable AIAG MSA-4 gate (GRR 12.27% <=30%, ndc 11 >=5) with a recommendation to improve repeatability. The baseline is stable under the stated point-limit Shewhart screen and is correctly described as stable but off-target and incapable; the capability indices are arithmetically consistent with a center above the USL. The applicator analysis supports only absence of a demonstrated individual-nozzle effect, and the report properly refrains from naming one. The post-change analysis is appropriately treated as provisional and observational, not as proof of permanent stability or causal attribution. No material unsupported focal inference is made.
reviews.evidence_problem: NONE material; step 13 uses non-standard field aliases for pre/post change quantities, but the reported values are correctly computed and traceable.
